market.question: Will George Russell be the 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion?

assessment.reasoning: After Miami GP (round 4), Russell is 2nd with 80pts behind teammate Antonelli's 100pts (3 wins in a row). With ~20 races remaining, Antonelli is the form favorite at the same Mercedes team. Russell needs to overhaul a teammate on a hot streak — possible but he's not the lead Mercedes story.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Reliability/development pace; whether Antonelli's run continues or regresses
